description: This file is a PHP script for executing search operations within the TestLink open-source testing platform. It handles search queries across test cases, test suites, requirements, and requirement specifications, generating HTML tables for displaying results and managing search parameters.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class for rendering extended table views for search results, with functionalities for sorting, grouping, and custom behavior.

methods.name: buildTCExtTable
methods.description: Builds an HTML table for displaying test case search results, sorted and grouped by test suite.

methods.name: buildTSExtTable
methods.description: Builds an HTML table for displaying test suite search results.

methods.name: buildRSExtTable
methods.description: Builds an HTML table for displaying requirement specification search results.

methods.name: buildRQExtTable
methods.description: Builds an HTML table for displaying requirement search results.

methods.name: cleanUpTarget
methods.description: Sanitizes and prepares target set array for search filtering.
